title: Faith on the map: religion around the world and across the UK
excerpt: Christianity's centre has moved to sub-Saharan Africa, the unaffiliated are growing fast, and in Scotland 51.1% now say they have no religion. A map of religion in 201 countries, every UK neighbourhood and 1,624,818 places of worship.
seo_description: An interactive map of religion around the world and across the UK, from Pew Research Center estimates, the UK censuses and OpenStreetMap.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Faith on the map' in black and blue on cream, beside a world map coloured by each country's largest religious group in 2020: Christians in blue, Muslims in green, the unaffiliated in violet, Hindus in orange and Buddhists in maroon. Text: the largest religious group in 201 countries and territories, and religion in every UK neighbourhood; Scotland 51.1% no religion.
